paragraphs: ContinuumCloud sells cloud-based software to behavioral health and human services organizations. The suite has three parts: an EHR platform powered by Welligent, an HCM system powered by DATIS e3, and a patient engagement platform powered by CaredFor.

The EHR handles caseload, schedule, documentation, and revenue cycle in one platform. The workforce software spans the employee lifecycle, including recruiting, payroll, timekeeping, talent management, benefits, and workforce analytics. The engagement platform is a social app meant to connect clients, alumni, and their families.

The company aims at organizations that need to meet the six core CCBHC requirements. Its stated audience also covers substance use treatment, group therapy, community support, and MAT services. Public health, school-based care, senior care, and advocacy work are named as well. Offices are in Tampa, Florida and Norfolk, Virginia, with remote positions available.
